values.note: 38 tent/RV sites, 15 lean-tos and 8 horse-camping sites, plus remote lean-tos and tent sites at Osmore Pond (the 2026 map says 36 tent/trailer sites). On the booking site 24 sites take 28 ft or more (horse sites included); the only pull-throughs are horse sites.

sites.source: https://www.vtstateparks.com/parks/new-discovery ('Camping: 38 tent/RV sites, 15 lean-to sites and 8 horse-camping sites.') + vtstateparks-visit.com parkId 1280081 site list (T23 45 ft; pull-through only on T37HORSE and T47HORSE), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://www.vtstateparks.com/parks/new-discovery ('A sanitary dump station is available, but there are no hookups.'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.vtstateparks.com/parks/new-discovery ('All restrooms include flush toilets, hot and cold running water, and token-operated hot showers.' 'A sanitary dump station is available'), read 2026-11-11

note: On a wooded hillside in Groton State Forest, with horse-camping sites and remote lean-tos and tent sites at Osmore Pond, reached by trail; swimming is at nearby Boulder Beach State Park. --Claude
summary: Park page + RA + 2026 map: 38 tent/RV (map 36) + 8 horse sites, max 45 ft (T23); pull-throughs are horse sites only (pull_through not set); no hookups; flush toilets, token showers, dump. Not waterfront confirmed. Season manual not overwritten. Phone 802-426-3042 (stored blank).
